full_judgment:
Latifur Rahman, J.: This appeal at the instance of the plaintiff-appellant is directed against the judgment and decree dated 18.8.93 passed by a Division Bench of the High Court Division in First Appeal No. 53 of 1992, allowing the appeal, preferred by defendant-respondent No. 1 against the judgment and decree passed by the Subordinate Judge and Commercial Court No. 2, Dhaka on 16th March, 1991 in Title Suit No. 12 of 1986 decreeing the suit in favour of the plaintiff. 

 6. The appellant instituted the aforesaid suit for several declarations, namely, that the claim of defendant No. 1 against the plaintiff in respect of U.K. foreign currency loan under the 5th, 6th (Original) 6 (expansion), 8th, 9th, 14th and 18th credit or in local currency amounting to Tk. 17,82,547.00 or any other amount whatsoever is illegal, malafide and not payable by the plaintiff; for a decree that the plain-tiff is entitled to Tk. 1,87,42,611.83 by way of refund and/or such other sum with reasonable compensations as may be found just and fair which was realised from the plaintiff by defendant No. 1 under coercion, duress and miscalculation; that the demand of money against the exchange risk commission made by defendant No. 1 and realised from the plaintiff is illegal, that the interest claim of defendant No, 1 against the plaintiff in respect of period from 1 May, 1971 upto filing of this suit was illegal and not binding upon the plaintiff; that the exchange fluctuation claim of defendant No. 1 against the plaintiff in respect of period from 1 May, 1971 till filing of the suit was illegal and not binding upon the plaintiff; that the foreign loan waived is non-existent and obligation of the plaintiff to repay them has extinguished, that the rate of interest overriding 72% being against the stipulation or the promoters agreement dated 25 July, 1963 and amended promoters' agreement dated 12 June, 1965 was illegal and void. The appellant also prayed for a decree for money by way of damages and compensation as may be found equitable by the Court, and or per-manent injunction restraining the defendant from taking any action for recovery of any amount of money from the plaintiff. 

 8. The trial Court decreed the suit. It was declared "that the claim of defendant No. 1 against the plaintiff in respect of the U.K. loan under the 5th, 6th 8th, 9th, 14th and 18th Credit and any claim there-under are void, illegal and not binding upon the plaintiff and it is further declared that the plaintiff do realise a sum of Tk. 2,87,42,611.83 by way of refund from defendant No. 1 and defendant No. 1 shall have no claim whatsoever against plaintiff on account of the U.K. loan or other loan." 

 9. On appeal the High Court Division set aside the judgment and decree of the trial court and dismissed the suit.
